rationale: Sandeep is building ReWorks.in, a B2B merch company focused on developer communities and open-source ecosystems, while Rid is an applied ML researcher with hands-on experience building developer-facing AI and robotics infrastructure. Rid's technical depth in Python, TypeScript, and multi-agent systems could inform product decisions for tools that serve technical audiences, and Sandeep's 4 years of community-building experience at Koii gives him insights into what developer communities actually need—a complementary mix of business strategy and technical capability.
intro_message: Sandeep Singh, meet Rid M — you're both deep in developer-facing tech (community/merch vs. ML infra) and could explore how B2B tools for technical audiences get built and distributed.
